{{Expand Slovene|date=April 2008|topic=bio|Andrej Čadež}}
'''Andrej Čadež''' (born September 12, 1942 in [[Ljubljana]]) is a [[Slovenes|Slovene]] [[physicist]] and [[astrophysicist]].

He is the author of ''Fizika zvezd'' published in Ljubljana in 1986.
